newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Semapa's CMP launches 9.5 bln esc 10-yr bonds.
newsitem.headline: Semapa's CMP launches 9.5 bln esc 10-yr bonds.

text.p: CMP-Cimentos Maceira e Pataias, part of Portuguese cement holding Semapa-SGPS, is launching 9.5 billion escudos in 10-year bonds indexed to three-month Lisbor plus five basis points with call and put, said leader Banco Portugues de Investimento.
"The bond is aimed to reimburse a loan by the state to the Semapa group," BPI said.
NOMINAL VALUE AND SUBSCRIPTION PRICE: 1,000 escudos
INTEREST RATE: 3-mth Lisbor plus five bp
REIMBURSEMENT: via reduction in nominal value by following amounts:
CALL OPTION: Total or partial, on expiry dates of fourth and subsequent coupons, at par
PUT OPTION: At par, on expiry dates of 24th, 28th, 32nd and 36th coupons
ADMISSION FOR LISTING: Second market of Lisbon bourse
